Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is pathologically characterized by oxidative stress and disrupted energy metabolism, which is closely related to the overproduction of ATP and hypochlorite (ClO-). However, fluorescent probes capable of simultaneous detection of ATP and ClO- remain scarce.
